description: This file defines an interface for reading and retrieving loan product data within the Fineract loan module. It specifies various methods to fetch loan product details, collections of products based on different criteria, and associated data such as advanced payments and credit allocations.

classes.name: LoanProductReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods to access loan product data across the loan portfolio.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all loan products available in the system.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all loan products suitable for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all loan products suitable for lookup purposes based on class type.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all active loan products suitable for lookup.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific loan product by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves a loan product using an external identifier.

methods.name: retrieveNewLoanProductDetails
methods.description: Provides details necessary for creating a new loan product.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves loan products denominated in a specific currency.

methods.name: retrieveAvailableLoanProductsForMix
methods.description: Retrieves loan products available for product mix operations.

methods.name: retrieveRestrictedProductsForMix
methods.description: Retrieves loan products restricted within a specific product mix.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedProductsForMix
methods.description: Retrieves loan products permitted within a specific product mix.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductBorrowerCycleVariations
methods.description: Retrieves borrower cycle variations associated with a loan product.

methods.name: retrieveAdvancedPaymentData
methods.description: Retrieves data related to advanced payments for a specific loan product.

methods.name: retrieveCreditAllocationData
methods.description: Retrieves credit allocation data for a given loan product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductFloatingDetails
methods.description: Retrieves floating (variable) details for a specific loan product.
